title: KDA: A Knowledge-Distilled Attacker for Generating Diverse Prompts to Jailbreak LLMs

bias_targets.target: Bias and Hate (Race, Gender, Religion, Profession)
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of adversarial jailbreak prompts designed to bypass LLM safety filters and elicit harmful responses containing societal prejudices, discrimination, or hate speech based on attributes like race, gender, religion, and profession.
